title: Label text not visible in editor for existing nodes, but visible at runtime (Godot 4.5.1, Control/Label)
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.5.1.stable
(not tested in other versions yet)

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6650 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21030.2001) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

All existing Label nodes (Control/Label) no longer display their text in the editor viewport, but render correctly when the project is run.

The issue does not affect newly created Label nodes. Duplicating any single affected Label immediately fixes the problem for all Label nodes at once, but only until the project is saved, closed and opened again.

### Steps to reproduce

Could not reproduce the issue with new Label nodes yet.

Since I found this issue in my first attempt to work in Godot the project is very basic right now. The only properties changed are text, size, position, font_color, font (provided by a tutorial on youtube) and font_size. I can't provide the font here due to the file type not being accepted, but the assets are linked in the description of the tutorial.

Tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LOhfqjmasi0
Assets: https://brackeysgames.itch.io/brackeys-platformer-bundle

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Sadly, right now the .zip failes to be uploaded. I can provide it on demand, e.g. by mailing it or by uploading it on github. It's really small, the result of a few hours experimenting.
